newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's October oil output rises 6.8 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru's October oil output rises 6.8 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru produced an average of 124,865 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in October, up 6.8 percent from the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Thursday.
Peru's average production for the first ten months of the year was 120,274 bpd, the ministry added. It did not give a comparative figure for output in the same period of 1995.
Natural gas output in October averaged 23.943 million cubic feet per day, the ministry said. Gas production in the first ten months was an average 24.397 cubic feet per day.
Oil production in Peru dropped 4.36 percent last year to an average of 121,762 barrels a day (bpd).
U.S.-based firms Occidental Petroleum Corp, Petro-Tech S.A., Argentina's Pluspetrol and state oil company Petroperu S.A. account for more than 90 percent of Peru's total oil output.
